title: Cogfall
description:
The Clockwork Kingdom waits beneath your feet. Descend.Cogfall is a steampunk dungeon crawler that rewards patience, planning, and the perfect gear build. Descend through increasingly dangerous floors, defeat mechanical guardians, collect powerful gear, and return stronger than before.

── SIX GEAR SETS. INFINITE BUILDS. ──Counter, Shadow, Guardian, Power, Vitality, Arcane — each gear set plays differently and rewards full investment. Mix pieces for set bonuses, infuse them to push beyond their base stats, and reforge when the build isn't clicking.

── CLOCKWORK BLESSINGS ──Defeat a boss and choose a Clockwork Blessing — a permanent run modifier from a pool of dozens. Thick Oil heals you each new floor. Fortune's Favor floods your drops with rare gear. Wind Siphon recovers Wind on every kill.

── YOUR COMPANION GROWS WITH YOU ──Your companions are more than a pet — they are a combat partner. Level it up between runs to unlock passive abilities that synergize with your build.

── PERMANENT PROGRESSION ──The Talent Workshop lets you spend Springs on permanent account-wide upgrades. Max Windcraft for stronger Wind Rewinds. Max Treasure Clock for better loot. Max Titan Springs for a larger HP pool.

── WIND — THE HEART OF EVERY RUN ──Wind is your resource and your weapon. Spend it on powerful mid-combat abilities — Wind Rewind heals, Wind Surge crits, Wind Siphon recovers. Manage it carefully: run dry and you surface.

── WEEKLY CHALLENGES AND DAILY TASKS ──Fresh content every day and week. Daily tasks reward Springs and bonus gear. Weekly challenges target specific gear sets and push you to build differently.

── NO ADS. NO PAYWALLS. JUST THE KINGDOM. ──Cogfall on Steam is the complete experience. Every feature unlocked from the first descent. One price. Endless floors. How deep can you go?
description_short: Descend into a steampunk clockwork dungeon. Build your Tinker with deep gear sets, Clockwork Blessings, companion pets, and permanent talent upgrades. Every floor deeper, every boss defeated, every piece forged brings you closer to the perfect run.
